messages:
Ivy Nguyen: quick thread 14 — we need a playbook for remediation ownership. too many PMs and eng leads guessing who owns verification. propose a 4-tier ownership ladder + a buddy handoff for ICs. thoughts?

Carlos Mendez: +1. what do you mean by 4-tier ladder?

Ivy Nguyen: Tier 1 = Immediate owner (fixing code/config). Tier 2 = Verification owner (automated smoke or manual signoff). Tier 3 = Escalation owner (tech lead if SLAs missed). Tier 4 = Program owner (platform or product owning long-term work). Each remediation block should explicitly list the names for each tier.

Zoe Park: I like separating verification from immediate owner. often the author marks things done without tests. can we require a verification artifact (link to smoke test or run) before closing?

Ravi Shah: also recommend a 4-point IC buddy handoff: 1) readout of active remediations, 2) outstanding checkpoints, 3) who the verification owner is, 4) blocker list. buddy shadows for 2 hours on handoff day.

Ivy Nguyen: sample remediation snippet to paste in a PM or ticket (single-line keys for easy parse):

```
remediation: Short summary
owner_t1: Name (team)
owner_t2: Name (verification)
owner_t3: Name (escalation)
owner_t4: Name (program)
priority: P0|P1|P2
due: YYYY-MM-DD
verification_artifact: URL or smoke-id
regression_check: auto|manual
failure_mode: tag1,tag2
checkpoints: 24h:status, 72h:status, 14d:status
pm_link: URL
notes: short free text
```

Carlos Mendez: 24h checkpoint is aggressive but good for fast followups. ops-bot can be asked to post reminders and escalate to owner_t3 at 72h if no progress.

Zoe Park: add a small "prevented_by" field to describe intended guardrail. helps when we run monthly trend analysis.

Ravi Shah: governance: if owner_t1 misses 24h -> owner_t2 notified; if owner_t2 hasn't verified by 72h -> owner_t3 escalated; if owner_t4 hasn't scheduled a long-term fix within 14d -> auto-open a program planning ticket and notify product. ops-bot should make these actions auditable.

Ivy Nguyen: for IC rotation: propose 5-day shifts with a fixed buddy handoff on day 5. IC picks comms cadence at declare: options are "rapid" (initial/15m/30m/1hr/final) or "steady" (initial/30m/1hr/final). ops-bot pins the cadence to the incident thread.

Carlos Mendez: also propose a small "recurrence-checklist" field listing: monitoring_added, runbook_updated, deploy-guard. checkbox style so we can count completeness.

Zoe Park: implementation note: parser should accept the block as key:value pairs and tolerate commas in failure_mode. output will be a CSV that the weekly "recurrence radar" job ingests. I can prototype the parser.

Ravi Shah: operationally, the recurrence radar should surface top failure_modes and % of remediations with complete verification. target: >90% verification within 14d. if below, ops and eng leads get a heatmap and a 1-hour triage.

ops-bot: Policy draft saved: remediation-ownership-ladder v0.1. Checkpoint scheduler created for REM-2024-900 (owner_t1: Ivy Nguyen) at 24h -> 3141595090.

Ivy Nguyen: action items from this thread:
- Zoe: prototype parser + csv exporter for recurrence radar (owner: Zoe, due: 10 days)
- Carlos: add "recurrence-checklist" checkbox UI proposal in runbook (owner: Carlos, due: 5 days)
- Ravi: write escalation automation steps for ops-bot (owner: Ravi, due: 4 days)
- Ivy: draft RFC for the 4-tier ladder + IC buddy policy and add remediation snippet to current PM (owner: Ivy, due: 3 days)

Carlos Mendez: confirmed, will push to docs.

Zoe Park: confirmed, starting parser tomorrow.

Ravi Shah: confirmed, will draft automation rules.

Ivy Nguyen: thanks everyone. short sync tomorrow 9:30am PT for 20m if you can join. ops-bot, please nudge the channel 30m before.
